title: Bluegrass Brunch @ Mercury Lounge
event_description: Weekly bluegrass brunch featuring Johnny Mullenax Band and rotating cast of Tulsa musicians. A freewheeling set of country - folk - and blues with electric instruments. Family-friendly daytime show.
event_venue_information:
About Mercury Lounge

Mercury Lounge is a converted gas station on the corner of 18th and Boston that has been voted Tulsa's Best Bar with the Best Bartenders. This dive bar by day transforms into a nationally recognized music venue by night - hosting live original music 7 nights a week.

Music Events

The venue regularly showcases local - regional - and national artists across genres including alt/americana/bluegrass/red dirt/country/punk/funk/rock. The legendary Bluegrass Brunch on Sundays has become a must-experience event in the Tulsa music scene. Ticketed shows run most nights - with house resident artists playing late shows on weekdays at no cover charge.

Venue Amenities

Features include an open patio - covered patio with fireplace - pool table - and vintage jukebox. The venue has capacity for 150 people and is LGBTQIA affirming. Known for excellent sound quality and authentic dive bar atmosphere with eclectic decor.

title: Pickin' in the Park @ The Gathering Place
event_description: Family-friendly bluegrass acoustic jam session welcoming all skill levels. Bring your acoustic instrument - singing voice - and love of bluegrass - folk - jazz - and swing for a casual - no-pressure jam.
venue_address: 2650 S John Williams Way - Tulsa - OK 74114
event_venue_information:
About The Gathering Place

The Gathering Place is a world-class riverfront park offering amazing attractions and programming for all ages with no entry fee. Named Best City Park by USA Today - the park has become a symbol of Tulsa's diverse and vibrant community.

Music and Events

Year-round programming includes children's events - live music - artistic performances - and sports-related activities. The Pickin' in the Park bluegrass jam sessions are held at Williams Lodge in a beautiful park setting. From concerts on the QuikTrip Great Lawn to intimate jam sessions - every trip to Gathering Place promises musical experiences for all.

Park Features

The 100-acre park features beautiful gardens - trails - playgrounds - aquatic features - and cultural events at no cost. BMX and skate parks - boathouse with paddleboats - and the Chapman Adventure Playground offer activities for all ages.

title: Free Energy Jazz Jam @ LowDown
event_description: All-ages open jazz jam session hosted by The Mike Cameron Quartet. Performers of all ages can play with local musicians in front of a live audience. Unique collaborations between different generations and music genres.
backline: Yamaha C7 grand piano - bass amp - drum set - PA system provided
event_venue_information:
About LowDown

LowDown is Tulsa's premier jazz club located in the basement of the historic Archer Building in the heart of the Tulsa Arts District. This contemporary live music venue and cocktail bar features speakeasy vibes with world-class sound quality.

Music Programming

Hosts performances of all genres from live music to comedy to community jam sessions. The Free Energy all-ages jazz jam sessions on the 2nd and 4th Wednesdays offer rare collaborative opportunities. Features touring jazz artists - local performers - and special themed events like the annual Charlie Brown Christmas shows.

Venue Details

Intimate 140-seat listening room provides close connection to performers. State-of-the-art sound system and lighting. Signature craft cocktails available. Shows typically Thursday-Saturday evenings. Enter through Duet restaurant or via wheelchair-accessible elevator in alley.

title: Jazz Jam @ Oklahoma Jazz Hall of Fame
event_description: Free open jam session welcoming jazz musicians and singers of all skill levels. Jazz jam from 6:00-8:00 PM followed by blues jam from 8:00-10:00 PM. High level of musicianship in friendly - casual atmosphere.
backline: Basic backline - Yamaha grand piano - jazz drum kit provided
event_venue_information:
About Oklahoma Jazz Hall of Fame

The Oklahoma Jazz Hall of Fame is housed in the historic Art Deco Tulsa Union Depot. This non-profit organization honors jazz - blues - and gospel musicians with Oklahoma ties. Part museum - performance hall - and educational facility dedicated to creating unity through music.

Weekly Jam Sessions

Every Tuesday features free jazz and blues concerts from 6:00-10:00 PM. The jam sessions provide living - breathing exhibits where real jazz happens. All artists regardless of skill level - race - or gender are welcome in this open and inclusive environment. Donations for drinks support the Hall of Fame.

Facility Features

On-site music library with video - audio - and photographic materials. Photographs of jazz greats line the walls. Art gallery with sculptures depicting musical themes. Regular concerts - classes - and cultural events raise awareness of jazz - blues - and gospel music traditions.
